About me

Hi, I'm Alex. I build data platforms that people can trust. I've lived in Porto since 2024, after five years in Lisbon. Before that I lived in Seville and worked in Madrid. I grew up in Valencia, so I speak Spanish and English, and I'm slowly learning Portuguese.

I care about boring, reliable pipelines, clear documentation and teams that share knowledge. Outside work I go bouldering and bake sourdough bread.

Alex has done calisthenics every morning for ten years: it is his longest-running habit. Python sits at the centre of his toolkit.

Projects

Atlas Migration

Since 2026 I've been leading the Atlas Migration at Northwind Labs: we are moving all nightly batch pipelines from a legacy Hadoop cluster to a managed cloud warehouse. It uses Airflow for orchestration and dbt for transformations.

Tidepool

Tidepool is a small open-source library for data quality checks that I started in 2022. I maintain it together with my friend Sam Okafor. Its code lives on CodeHarbor and its test suite runs on the public TripLog dataset (record TL4521).
